interface.longDescription:
Find open-licensed biology illustrations for research papers, teaching, slides and posters. Search the BioCartoon catalog by topic or collection, compare selected candidates in an interactive gallery, download PNG files and SVGs where available, and copy the credit lines required by each illustration's license. Browse shared slide templates and explore an illustration's available colour or style variants. Compose figures from catalog artwork with labels and arrows, export SVGs, and open a copy in the BioCartoon editor through an encrypted share link. Figure inputs are processed by the hosted server; editor links expire after 90 days without use.

When the library does not contain a suitable illustration, the bundled skills guide the assistant through creating or adapting artwork using the host's available drawing and image-generation tools. With your explicit approval, submit a PNG or SVG and its metadata to BioCartoon's human-reviewed contribution queue. Generative-AI artwork can be contributed only under CC0. Approval and publication are separate from submission.

The public catalog and hosted MCP tools require no BioCartoon sign-in. Illustrations retain their individual licenses; the library is not uniformly CC0. Hosted artwork uploads accept PNG or SVG up to 2 MB. Conversion and resizing are available through the local BioCartoon CLI.

prompts: Find some illustrations of pyramidal neurons for a neuroscience lecture slide.
Show me the other color or style variants of BioCartoon illustration BA001505.
Make an SVG icon in the style of BioCartoon illustration BA001505, but make the axon even longer, make the cell blue, and make the nucleus pink.
Submit the generated image above to the BioCartoon library.
Make a figure in BioCartoon with the blue-pink neuron generated above, as well as some glial cells (astrocytes, microglia, oligodendrocyte).

publication.release_notes: Initial public MCP-backed BioCartoon plugin package. Bundles the find-icons, create-icon, make-figure and upload skills with the hosted catalog tools and interactive icon gallery. Supports catalog search, PNG/SVG links and credits, colour/style variants, shared slide templates, figure composition, SVG export, encrypted editor links and explicitly confirmed contributions held for human review. The hosted server uses a stateless Cloudflare Worker and a separate public catalog database.
